# hatsu_ino

> Arduino-based JDM car melody box that plays a WAV audio file through a speaker when the car's ignition turns on, then sleeps until the next start.

hatsu_ino ("hatsu" = first sound, "ino" = Arduino) is an open-source (MIT licensed) hardware + firmware project that plays an audio file through a speaker when the car's ignition turns on, then sleeps until the next start. Each board revision is self-contained under `boards/<version>/`, with its own wiring guide and Arduino sketch — see the boards folder link below for the current list and each one's README for details and status (working, deprecated, work in progress, etc).

## Docs

- [Rendered docs site](https://arturvrsampaio.github.io/hatsu_ino/): project overview and up-to-date board list, generated from whatever's in `boards/` at each deploy
- [Boards folder](https://github.com/ArturVRSampaio/hatsu_ino/tree/master/boards): browse all board versions directly; each `boards/<version>/README.md` has that board's components, wiring, and setup instructions

## Source

- [Root README](https://github.com/ArturVRSampaio/hatsu_ino/blob/master/README.md): repository layout and dev commands
- [LICENSE](https://github.com/ArturVRSampaio/hatsu_ino/blob/master/LICENSE): MIT
- [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/ArturVRSampaio/hatsu_ino/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md): how to add a board variant, fix a bug, or improve the docs
